item-handbooktext-chefhead: Also known as a toque blanche, this hat was worn by members of the ancient Gastronomist's Guild to signal their rank and political neutrality to the rest of society. As the world turned to rot, the venerable Gastronomist's toque became little more than a relic, never to grace a warm kitchen again. Hands that once grasped rolling pins and frying pans instead had to wield sword and shield to protect the dying hearth.
item-handbooktext-l33tapron: Any unknown person caught wearing the black cotton apron of the highest-ranking gastronomists was harshly punished. To be worthy of the dark regalia, many chefs toiled away for decades - but the right combination of vision and practical experience was hard to acquire. Entire generations went by without any elite gastronomists. Each swore a vow unto the ancient 'Source Culinaire' before taking the black and renouncing their former identities, fully consigning their lives to the advancement of culinary enlightenment.
item-handbooktext-l33that: The fell toque noire has only graced the brows of royal gastronomists. Fearless knights of sensation, the most elite chefs are as at home in the frigid wilds as they are in a boiling kitchen, pushing the horizons of taste and elegance with exquisite precision. These paragons were relentlessly nomadic, never content to limit themselves to a singular court, and their stately hats ensured they had free reign in any kitchen.
